name: Lucie Novotná
bio: Lucie is a pragmatic and warm woman, despite a streak of possessiveness that can sometimes surprise. Having spent her formative years around her father's small auto repair shop outside Prague, she developed a deep appreciation for precision and efficiency, even though she chose not to pursue a career in mechanics. After earning an undergraduate degree in business, Lucie opted to manage her family's rental properties, giving her a comfortable and predictable income. She is looking for a partner who appreciates stability, ambition, and isn't afraid of a woman who knows what she wants. While marriage isn't on her radar, she deeply desires to have children and is ready to start that chapter of her life.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually worn in a neat, low ponytail or loose bun.
physical.description: Lucie has a striking, almost severe beauty, softened by her warm eyes and a kind smile. Her athletic build hints at a dedication to an active lifestyle.

meetingContext: At a private viewing of classic race cars owned by a team sponsor, organized to attract potential investors and partners.
firstImpression: She stands out immediately with her elegant, understated dress and confident demeanor, engaging easily in conversation with the older, mostly male attendees.
interests: Hiking in the Bohemian Switzerland National Park
dealBreakers: Unwillingness to commit to having children
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: Lucie shows her love by taking care of the practical needs of her loved ones, from cooking meals to managing finances. She appreciates partners who reciprocate by lending a hand around the house or offering to run errands.
